chunks: The day it comes no soul will dare say a word but by His leave; and some will be wretched, some will be blessed.
ai.seo_question: What happens to human speech on the Day of Resurrection according to Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah over speech on the Day of Judgment, where the 'wretched' and 'blessed' are distinguished by their eternal destinies. It reflects the theological concept of divine decree (Qadr) and the finality of judgment, where human agency yields to God's permission. The distinction serves as a reminder of the ultimate justice that separates those who followed the path of truth from those who strayed.
